The '''Mission to Ryvester''' was a covert operation conducted by [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]]<ref name="XW:MK" /> in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> The Wraiths arranged a meeting between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] and Captain Hachat, the alias of [[Garik Loran]], who posed as [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] seeking a partner to recover riches from [[The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes]], which he claimed to have discovered. To convince Teradoc of the treasure's authenticity, Loran presented a gemstone statuette that had been examined by the gemstone [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Mulus Cheems]], a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] whom Teradoc had brought to the meeting. Unbeknownst to Teradoc, the statuette was made from a modified form of [[anthracite]], a powerful explosive material.<ref name="XW:MK" />

When Teradoc attempted to double cross Hachat by abducting him for [[Interrogation (Imperial Intelligence)|interrogation]], Loran signaled the other undercover Wraiths, who had infiltrated the club as employees. A brief skirmish followed, during which the Wraiths subdued Teradoc's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] before escaping aboard the admiral's [[Teradoc's yacht|yacht]] with Cheems. Teradoc fled separately with the rigged gemstone statuette, bringing it back to his personal vault within the [[Imperial Navy base (Ryvester)|Imperial Navy base]] on the planet, where it later detonated as part of the Wraiths' deception.<ref name="XW:MK" />
